profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Professional Experience:
Software Engineer with experience in medical device, aerospace and defense in software design, development, and test using C#, C++, Ada, Pascal, FORTRAN, and C.  Constructed software test plans.  Executed verification and validation testing in a medical device environment in compliance with FDA regulations.   Knowledge of UNIX, Windows, VMS and DOS.

Specialties: • Proven track record managing software development lifecycle (SDLC)
 • Creative problem solver 
 • Multi-language, multi-platform software development
 • Knowledge of object oriented analysis and design

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
Updating and creating inertial navigation test drivers using C++, and matlab, in linux and windows environments. 
•	Developing and modifying test scripts to perform data reduction of information gathered from gyros and accelerometers using matlab.
•	Modifying and enhancing GTK C++ in a linux environment to add popup textboxes and drop down menus.  This includes formatting and adding the new information to the printouts and .db files.
•	Designing enhancements to MS Visual C++ data collector to format the data into XML and HTML files.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Updating  and creating web applications,  using C#, asp.net in a .Net environment to interface with a mainframe back end.
•	Developing asp.net web pages using Visual Studio 2013 using c# and javascript to send data that interface with a 3270 and displays information on a web page.

positions.title: .Net Programmer
positions.description:
Updating web applications and writing reports using C# and Visual Basic in a .Net environment.
• Writing console application reports that access and ODBC database tables and present data for management
• Writing Visual Basic web applications to format invoices in PDF and save them in an SQL database
• Developing Tools to update, insert and retrieve data from the database to screens correction and verification.
• Implemented vb.net, C#.net, ascx controls,  Javascript and JQuery  code to display, modify, insert and update data in an SQL database.
• Writing C# web applications to display employee tests in a web form, saves the answers in XML in an SQL database.  The application retrieves the XML and displays previous answers if an existing test occurs.
• Developed windows service listener event handlers in C# to track the status Avaya phone queues and calls waiting.
• Developed xslt files to format customer emails.
• Developed an asmx web service to format phone numbers and implement link button calling in c#.
• Wrote a C# web application to read data from an Excel spreadsheet and display information depending on the selection of dropdown menus. 
• Tracking projects and defects and projects using Jira.

positions.title: Software Product Assurance III
positions.description:
Writing test scripts, verifying requirements in an agile/scrum environment for an integrated gaming operations system linking slot machine management, gaming tables and marketing.
 * Defining events to test scenarios for customer promotions
 * Performing SQL queries to verify data
 * Analyzing log files to isolate errors
 * Installing Virtual Workstations and Communication Servers using Lab Manager and V-Sphere clients
 * Filing Defects and verifying solutions
 * Writing test cases for user story verification.

positions.title: Software QA
positions.description:
Writing test plans to verify proper implementation of remote XML messages in sports book betting on kiosk, android, blackberry and iPhone applications.
•	Reviewing requirements documentation to design tests that map to requirements 
•	Defining events to test scenarios for all possible cases 
•	File bug reports and verify solutions

company.name: Robert Half on site at William Hill

positions.title: Test Engineer II
positions.description:
Triaged defects and developed test tools for printer firmware in an agile environment.
 • Triaged and analyzed failing tests, isolated defects, filed CR's (Change Requests) using Quality Center (formerly Mercury) and assigned an owner 
 • Tool development using C# in Visual Studio 2008 
 • Developed a screen scraper in C# with Visual Studio 2008 that read HTML web pages from the intranet using an HTTPWebRequest and a proxy server
 • Wrote a C# class library that parsed the HTML and extracted information regarding failing tests
 • Developed a Windows Form application using C# in Visual Studio 2008 that displayed the failed tests in order of priority together with a link to the intranet web page that contained further information 
 • Reproduced defects on emulators and simulators
 • Tracked defects in Quality Center
 • Verified solutions including coordination with off-shore developers
 • Experienced with Git version control software

positions.title: Computer Specialist
positions.description:
Responded to customer computer problem reports, identified and resolved technical issues.
•	Provided technical support and assistance on all aspects of computer operations
•	Maintained multi-protocol local area network supporting Windows 3.11, Windows 95, Windows NT and Novell 3.x servers
•	PC software and hardware trouble-shooter

company.name: US Department of Defense, OPM-SANG, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created code and documentation following established software engineering practices and procedures.
•	Researched software problem reports, identified problems, and made necessary modifications to existing Pascal software to correct the problems
•	Composed software validation test protocols to test modifications
•	Integrated a laser camera interface into the existing system written in Microsoft Visual C++
•	Participated in peer code reviews and design reviews 
•	Drafted requirements, design, and test documents in accordance with company standards
•	Lead the team to draft the company coding standards document
•	Created a checksum routine on a PC using Microsoft Visual C++ to verify the integrity of the executable
•	Performed verification and validation testing in compliance with FDA regulations

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Accountable for unit testing of the SH-2G helicopter simulator.
•	Analyzed requirements to determine unit test criteria
•	Composed software test plans to perform unit testing
•	Created Ada test drivers that executed unit test plans on a Sun workstation 
•	Wrote interrupt handlers in Ada targeted to a 68030 processor to accept interrupts generated by the 1553B data bus controller
•	Created Ada applications to simulate remote terminals by constructing the responses defined by the 1553B data bus protocol
•	Trained engineers in the Ada programming language

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Supported projects, evaluated commercially available products and made recommendations in support of projects.
•	Identified areas of poor performance by gathering timing data for P3 Update 4 using the Cadre Software Analysis workstation with a 68020 target probe in the software avionics integration lab
•	Benchmarked Ada UNIX/68020 cross compilers using the Tektronix In-Circuit Emulator (ICE),  a VME-133A, and UNIX shell scripts to make recommendations to projects
•	Evaluated COTS tools to incorporate Ada software development into BASE (Boeing Automated Software Engineering)
•	Wrote loader programs in Ada to convert hexadecimal compiler output into other binary formats.  These included checksum calculations

positions.title: Statistical Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for energy accounting.
•	Created FORTRAN programs as required for special projects and rate studies
•	Drove automation of allocating energy resources to industrial loads and surplus sales
